about: Scripted manager runs: a board of tasks t_1..t_<tasks> assigned to claude, one planning call already made, then one supervise pass per script step at `at` seconds into the run. `set` moves tasks on the board ([task, state, holder]) before the pass, `reply` is the model's answer if the pass asks it, `check` is the exit code of every verify run the pass makes due. `log` is every line the run prints and `report` its last word. src-tauri/src/manager.rs's `the_scripted_runs` executes this file; `npm run eval:manager:selftest` checks it covers what it must and runs that test.
